subject: Vendor onboarding: request for legal entity snapshot & PO contacts
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@orchidinstrumentation.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: vendor profile & PO contact details needed

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — excited to get Orchid set up in Redwood's system. To keep things moving on our side, attaching our preliminary vendor intake form (orchid_vendor_onboarding_form_v1.pdf). Can you confirm the exact fields you need for the vendor master so we can populate cleanly? At minimum we'll provide: legal name, registered address, EIN, entity type, remit address, billing contact, and PO contact (name + email + phone).

Two quick context items:
- Orchid is a single-member LLC registered in DE (we use the trade name "Orchid Instruments" for contracting).
- We prefer ACH; we don't push bank wiring over email — happy to share banking through your secure vendor portal or DocuSign if you have one.

Target timeline on our side is to have the completed form back to you by EOD Friday (2026-05-29). If there are any additional compliance artifacts (W-9 or VAT certificates) we should attach, please let us know now so we don't miss anything.

Attachments: orchid_vendor_onboarding_form_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Operations Manager
Orchid Instrumentation LLC
maya@orchidinstrumentation.com | +1 (415) 555-0112
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@orchidinstrumentation.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: vendor profile & PO contact details needed

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the form. CC'ing Marcus from Vendor Operations to help with master-record requirements.

Quick clarifications so Finance creates the vendor correctly:
- Legal name on the W-9 needs to match EXACTLY what you want on invoices and tax reporting. If Orchid Instruments is a DBAs under Orchid Instrumentation LLC, we need both the legal name and the DBA.
- For PO routing we store a single "PO contact" and a separate "invoice/billing" contact — if you want PO acknowledgments sent to a different person, include both.
- If your entity is a single-member LLC, please indicate whether the EIN is the entity EIN or the owner's SSN (we cannot accept SSNs in the vendor file).

We can accept bank details via DocuSign/secure portal. I attached our vendor master template for fields to map. If you can return the onboarding form plus a signed W-9, we'll start the vendor creation.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_master_template.xlsx

Thanks — I expect this to be a quick one once we have the completed form.
Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Date: 2026-05-27T09:14:00-07:00

Hi Soojin — attaching the completed intake and signed W-9 (orchid_w9_signed.pdf). Answers inline below:

- Legal name: Orchid Instrumentation LLC (this is the name on the W-9).
- DBA/Trade name: Orchid Instruments (please show both; invoices will say Orchid Instruments but legal entity must be Orchid Instrumentation LLC).
- Entity type: Single-member LLC (DE).
- EIN: 12-3456789 (entity EIN).
- Registered address: 412 Harbor Way, Suite 210, San Francisco, CA 94107.
- Remit address (for checks): same as registered address.
- PO contact: Hannah Wu, procurement@orchidinstrumentation.com, +1 (415) 555-0133.
- Invoice contact: accounting@orchidinstrumentation.com (AP team monitors).

We will not send banking info over email. If you can send the DocuSign envelope for bank details, we'll complete that immediately.

Attachments: orchid_vendor_onboarding_form_v1-complete.pdf, orchid_w9_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Maya
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@orchidinstrumentation.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: vendor profile & PO contact details needed

Thanks — I've received the W-9 and completed form. Next steps from Vendor Ops: creating vendor master record in the ERP, linking PO contact and invoice contact, and flagging ACH as "pending bank verification." Estimated ETA: 3 business days (create job today; target completion 2026-05-31).

Question for Soojin / Karthik: do we want to enable immediate PO issuance once the vendor record is created, or hold POs until bank verification completes? My preference: allow POs but block invoice payments until ACH verification is done — that avoids blocking the customer's procurement while still protecting payments.

I'll update the related Drive intake sheet and attach the ERP vendor ID once created.

Marcus Lin
